tag_id.description: ID of one of the user's tags (the `id` from `create_tag`, or from `call_endpoint` with endpoint_id "tags").

name.description: Short name, unique among the user's tags: letters, numbers, hyphens and underscores only, e.g. `patent-cases`. It appears in the tag's URL.

description.description: What the tag collects, in Markdown.

published.description: Whether anyone can see the tag and its dockets. Tags are private unless published.
